title: Dialog shows the three numbered steps in order
preconditions: Signed in as a test student with no saved school/program in user metadata; desktop width (1280 px)
steps: Open the "Your subjects this semester" dialog (My subjects)
Read the dialog from top to bottom
expected: Three numbered steps appear in this order: 1 "Your NYU school" (select), 2 "Your program" (select), 3 the subject search box together with the term select. No other step sits between them.

title: School select lists every NYU school by full name
preconditions: Signed in as a test student; dialog open
steps: Open the "Your NYU school" select
Compare the options with the school list in requirement section 6.1
expected: The select lists all 22 schools of 6.1 by full name, including College of Arts & Science, Courant Institute, Graduate School of Arts & Science, Stern School of Business, Tandon School of Engineering, Steinhardt, Tisch School of the Arts, Gallatin School of Individualized Study, School of Professional Studies, Silver School of Social Work, Wagner Graduate School of Public Service, School of Global Public Health, Rory Meyers College of Nursing, College of Dentistry, Grossman School of Medicine, Grossman Long Island School of Medicine, School of Law, Liberal Studies, Institute of Fine Arts, Institute for the Study of the Ancient World, NYU Abu Dhabi, NYU Shanghai. At least 20 options; none shown only by abbreviation; no duplicates.

title: Program select and subject search disabled until a school is chosen
preconditions: Signed in as a test student with no saved school/program; dialog open
steps: Without choosing a school, try to open the "Your program" select
Try to click and type "accounting" in the subject search box
Look for a hint near steps 2-3
expected: The program select is disabled (cannot open); the subject search box is disabled (no text can be entered, no search runs, no results list appears); a visible hint tells the student to choose a school first.

title: Choosing a school enables program and search and loads that school's programs
preconditions: Signed in as a test student with no saved school; dialog open
steps: Choose "Courant Institute" in "Your NYU school"
Open the "Your program" select
Click the subject search box
expected: The "choose a school first" hint disappears; the program select becomes enabled and lists Courant's programs, including an "Other / undeclared" option; the subject search box and term select are enabled and accept input.

title: Changing the school replaces the program list and resets the program
preconditions: Signed in as a test student; dialog open; school "Courant Institute" chosen and a Courant program (not Other / undeclared) selected
steps: Note the program options and the selected program
Change "Your NYU school" to "Stern School of Business"
Look at the program select, then open it
expected: The program select no longer shows the previously selected Courant program (it is reset to its empty/placeholder state); its options are now Stern's programs plus "Other / undeclared"; none of the Courant-only program options remain unless Stern has the same program name.

title: Every school offers Other / undeclared
preconditions: Signed in as a test student; dialog open
steps: Choose "Institute for the Study of the Ancient World" and open the program select
Choose "NYU Shanghai" and open the program select
Choose "Grossman Long Island School of Medicine" and open the program select
expected: For each school the program select loads that school's list and always contains "Other / undeclared"; the list is never empty and selecting "Other / undeclared" is accepted.

title: Courant student searching accounting: own school first, Stern in cross-registration
preconditions: Signed in as a test student; school "Courant Institute", any program; NYU search returns (mocked or real) for "accounting" in this order: ACCT-UB 1, ACCT-GB 6305, ECON-UA 266, CSCI-GA 2433
steps: Type "accounting" in the subject search box and wait for the debounced search
Read the result groups and tags
expected: First group heading "From Courant" containing only CSCI-GA 2433. Below it, heading "Other NYU schools · cross-registration" containing ACCT-UB 1 tagged "Stern", ACCT-GB 6305 tagged "Stern", ECON-UA 266 tagged "CAS", in that order. No course appears twice.

title: Stern student: Stern results first, NYU order kept inside each group
preconditions: Signed in as a test student; school "Stern School of Business"; NYU search for "accounting" returns ACCT-UB 1, ACCT-GB 6305, ECON-UA 266, CSCI-GA 2433 in that order
steps: Type "accounting" and wait for results
expected: Heading "From Stern" lists ACCT-UB 1 then ACCT-GB 6305 (NYU order). Heading "Other NYU schools · cross-registration" lists ECON-UA 266 tagged "CAS" then CSCI-GA 2433 tagged "Courant" (NYU order). Own-group rows carry no cross-registration tag.

title: No result from the chosen school: only cross-registration group, no empty heading
preconditions: Signed in as a test student; school "School of Law"; NYU search for "accounting" returns ACCT-UB 1, ACCT-GB 6305, ECON-UA 266, CSCI-GA 2433 (no -LW course)
steps: Type "accounting" and wait for results
expected: No "From Law" heading is shown (not even empty). Only the "Other NYU schools · cross-registration" group appears, listing all four courses in NYU order with tags Stern, Stern, CAS, Courant.

title: Course with an unknown code goes to cross-registration with no tag
preconditions: Signed in as a test student; school "Courant Institute"; mocked NYU search for "special topics" returns CSCI-GA 2433 and a course coded XYZW-QQ 101 (suffix not in 6.1)
steps: Type "special topics" and wait for results
expected: "From Courant" contains CSCI-GA 2433. XYZW-QQ 101 is listed under "Other NYU schools · cross-registration" with no school tag; it is not hidden and can be added with Add.

title: Code-to-school edge mappings (Courant vs CAS vs GSAS vs IFA/ISAW)
preconditions: Signed in as a test student; school "Graduate School of Arts & Science"; mocked NYU search returns HIST-GA 1000, MATH-GA 1002, FINH-GA 2000, ISAW-GA 3000, HIST-UA 10, DS-UA 201, SPAN-SHU 101, ARAB-UH 1001
steps: Type a query that returns the mocked results and wait
Read the groups and tags
expected: "From GSAS" contains only HIST-GA 1000. Cross-registration group lists, in NYU order: MATH-GA 1002 tagged "Courant", FINH-GA 2000 tagged "IFA", ISAW-GA 3000 tagged "ISAW", HIST-UA 10 tagged "CAS", DS-UA 201 tagged "Courant", SPAN-SHU 101 tagged "Shanghai", ARAB-UH 1001 tagged "Abu Dhabi".

title: Changing the school while results are shown regroups instantly without a new search
preconditions: Signed in as a test student; school "Courant Institute"; results for "accounting" shown as in TC-07; browser DevTools Network tab open (or mocked search call counter)
steps: Clear the Network log
Change "Your NYU school" to "Stern School of Business"
Observe the results list and the Network log
expected: The search text "accounting" stays; the same four results are immediately regrouped: "From Stern" with ACCT-UB 1, ACCT-GB 6305; cross-registration with ECON-UA 266 (CAS), CSCI-GA 2433 (Courant). No new subject-search request is made and no loading state appears. The program select resets (AC-4).

title: School and program are pre-filled when the dialog is reopened
preconditions: Signed in as a fresh test student with no saved school/program
steps: Open the dialog, choose "Tandon School of Engineering" and a Tandon program
Close the dialog
Reload the page and reopen the dialog
expected: On reopen, "Your NYU school" shows Tandon School of Engineering and "Your program" shows the same program; the subject search is enabled immediately (no 'choose a school first' hint).

title: Choice is saved to the account and appears on another device/browser
preconditions: Test student signed in on browser A; a separate clean browser profile B (no shared local storage)
steps: On browser A open the dialog and choose "Steinhardt" plus "Other / undeclared"
Close the dialog on A
On browser B sign in as the same test student and open the dialog
(Optional) inspect the session user's metadata
expected: On browser B the dialog opens with Steinhardt and Other / undeclared pre-filled. The user metadata contains nyu_school and nyu_program for the choice. No database table change is needed.

title: Changing a saved school updates the saved values
preconditions: Test student with saved school Tandon and a Tandon program
steps: Open the dialog, change school to "Stern School of Business" and pick a Stern program
Close, reload and reopen the dialog
expected: Reopened dialog shows Stern School of Business and the chosen Stern program; the old Tandon program is not shown.

title: Regression: debounced search and term select
preconditions: Test student; school "Courant Institute" chosen; Network tab open
steps: Type "algorithms" quickly (one character at a time without pausing)
Wait for results
Change the term select to a different term
expected: Only one search request is sent after typing stops (not one per keystroke); results appear grouped; changing the term re-runs the search for the new term and results update, still grouped by school.

title: Regression: Add/Added, To add list, Done adding
preconditions: Test student; school "Courant Institute"; results for "accounting" shown as in TC-07
steps: Click Add on CSCI-GA 2433 (own-school group)
Click Add on ACCT-UB 1 (cross-registration group)
Check the To add list and the buttons
Click the Done/enrol button
expected: Each clicked row's button changes to "Added"; both courses appear in the To add list; after Done the courses appear under "Your classes" and the To add list empties; the cross-registration course is added the same way as the own-school course.

title: Regression: Your classes with Remove
preconditions: Test student already enrolled in ACCT-UB 1 and CSCI-GA 2433 (from TC-17)
steps: Open the dialog
In "Your classes" click Remove on ACCT-UB 1
Search "accounting" again
expected: ACCT-UB 1 is removed from Your classes; CSCI-GA 2433 stays; in the new results ACCT-UB 1 shows "Add" again (not "Added").

title: Error handling: search fails, error box with Try again
preconditions: Test student; school chosen; subject search server function mocked to fail (or network blocked) on first call, succeed on retry
steps: Type "accounting" and wait
Click "Try again" in the error box
expected: An error box is shown with a "Try again" button (no crash, school/program selects keep their values); after Try again the results load and are grouped by school as in TC-07.

title: Error handling: saving school/program fails
preconditions: Test student; auth user-metadata update mocked to fail
steps: Open the dialog and choose "Tisch School of the Arts"
Type "film" in the subject search
expected: The dialog does not crash or block; the chosen school stays selected for this session and the search still runs and groups results under "From Tisch"; any save failure is reported without losing the dialog state.

title: Regression: keyboard use and focus return
preconditions: Test student; dialog closed; opener button for My subjects visible
steps: Using only the keyboard, open the dialog
Tab to the school select, choose a school with arrow keys/Enter; tab to program and choose one; tab to the search box and type
Press Escape (or Done)
expected: All three steps are reachable and operable with the keyboard in step order; the dialog closes and focus returns to the button that opened it.

title: Phone width 390 px: no horizontal scroll, selects and search usable
preconditions: Test student; browser viewport 390 x 844 (device emulation)
steps: Open the dialog
Choose "Grossman Long Island School of Medicine" (long name) and a program
Search "accounting" with results as in TC-07
Try to scroll horizontally in the dialog and page
expected: No horizontal scrollbar or horizontal scroll on page or dialog; long school names fit or wrap/truncate inside the select; both selects open and can be chosen; the search box and term select are fully visible and usable; group headings, school tags and Add buttons are visible without overflow.

title: Phone width 390 px: disabled state and hint visible
preconditions: Test student with no saved school; viewport 390 px
steps: Open the dialog
expected: Steps 1, 2, 3 are shown in order (stacked); program select and search are visibly disabled; the 'choose a school first' hint is readable without horizontal scroll.
